proof_scope: Fixed-background L1 convergence has the expected quasi-everywhere upper limit; bounded potentials converge in L1 of any fixed finite non-pluripolar measure. Exponentials have a common bounded quasi-psh background and converge in measure L1. Positive-mass model references in big classes admit unique full-mass solutions of every positive exponential equation, which are relative E1 variational maximizers. Lower bounds by densities converging almost everywhere survive volume L1 potential limits. Sending the exponential parameter to zero produces normalized full-mass solutions for arbitrary non-pluripolar measures of matching mass. Unweighted uniqueness is not claimed.
